findings.detail: idx_codebase_chunk_content_embedding_768_hnsw on canonical content_embedding_768 has ef_construction=64 (target specification is ef_construction=200).
agent_observations.hnsw_embedding has 2 duplicate HNSW indexes: idx_agent_observations_hnsw, idx_agent_observations_hnsw_768
chat_embeddings.embedding uses legacy IVFFlat ({'lists': '50'}) without an HNSW index.
cluster_summaries.summary_embedding maintains both a legacy IVFFlat index and an HNSW index, doubling write amplification without recall benefit.

codebase_chunk_index mixes fp32 vector_cosine_ops (canonical content_embedding_768, latent_64) and fp16 halfvec_cosine_ops (content_embedding, summary_embedding, error_embedding, latent_128, latent_256). Canonical semantic_768 remains fp32 vector_cosine_ops.
